# Template Data Processing Addendum

## Template Subprocessors

The standard template gives 15 days notice before adding a new subprocessor.

## Non-Binding Status

This template is for reference only.

It does not amend, override, or interpret any signed customer agreement unless Legal signs a separate amendment.

## Data Policy Preference

The preferred template asks vendors to host regulated data only in the United States.

This preference is not automatically part of any signed agreement.
